messages.content: You solve tasks. If you need to calculate or look up a fact, call tools instead of guessing. When the answer is ready, write it as the last line in the format FINAL: <answer>. For numeric tasks put only the number after FINAL, for factual questions a short phrase.
Who was dismissed as Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of Ukraine on 21 July 2026?

[2026 in Ukraine]
21 July – President Zelenskyy dismisses Oleksandr Syrskyi as Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, replacing him with Mykhailo Drapatyi amidst protests demanding Syrskyi’s removal.
